state.decision: Choose the least necessary trustworthy State/Work join for the actual native dispatch guard before physical claim or terminal skip. All proposals are unfinished implementation alternatives, not implemented APIs or acceptance.
verified_repository: State createSystemRegistry.run (ports/system.ts158–193) reads one physical revision, invokes the actual registered SystemCommandDef.stage with cloned JSON args and readers-only actor/now/operation/load/query context, validates effects and commits once with original expectedRevision. It has no issued stage checkpoint, private lifetime or commit-check enrollment port; no owner/Team authority is inferred from that context.

Work createWorkDispatchClaimCommand (kernel/commands.ts118–170) alone owns authoritative row loading, supersession, pending guard-false pin, deferral, live-held versus stale-reclaim, settled and optional installed-target availability refusals. Only eligibility stages the claimed-row write. Its default remains installed in the genuine registry; pending-only dispatchPreflight is not a substitute for stale-reclaim eligibility.

Work709 already implements runDispatchGuardPhase (dispatch/index.ts348–416). It freezes supplied lexical inputs/current snapshot/original intent/checkpoint, issues its private execution only during the actual callback, closes in finally, requires a strict Bool and retains a frozen one-shot revalidate callback for positive/negative observations. Repeat/concurrent evidence consumption poisons it. The phase neither certifies source lexical provenance nor reads/claims/commits storage. Every alternative below reuses this released phase; factoring it is no longer proposed work.

Work attemptDispatchAsync (dispatch/index.ts419–447) consumes that closed evidence before its existing false-skip or current-authority/logical-claim path. It is a decision API, not physical persistence; its preflight accepts pending only. The new owning claim join must validate current authority for BOTH true and false immediately before original commit, without changing legacy decision/default behavior or fabricating a pending item.

State bindScenarioDispatchMembershipProducer (invocation/dispatch-membership.ts) opens once on actual live Work execution, retains genuine current Identity Team/admission, exact checked source occurrences and fresh UserRef/Team pairs per evaluation. Its bounded private revalidation compares actual positive/negative Bool observations and original State revision after Work closes, without replaying native source. Separate Identity/State domains still do not provide cross-store atomicity or coherent arbitrary multi-subject saved disclosure.

Current native Dev driveDispatchIntent physically commits work.dispatch.claim (runtime/invoke.ts8785–8790) before runFenceGate. The async path opens a fresh checkpoint after claim, pins the real evaluator/kernel/explicit frozenInputs, reads the actual held row, rechecks current authority via its retained callback and refuses a moved physical checkpoint before skip/provider handling. Earlier cached-authority wording is stale. The physical guard-before-claim/terminal-skip continuation is still absent. Dev solely owns this native file and its future source-verified adoption.

Canonical stageCanonicalSend (kernel/dispatch-staging.ts453–458) already binds run key and originOperationId to actual admitted item.operationId; State authored-delivery validates that business operation. Generic work.dispatch.stage can retain a distinct originOperationId from its operator run key. Preserve these actual profiles and existing Images/Text correlation equality; do not invent a missing canonical origin issuer.

OutboxIntent.arguments is provider payload, not source lexical capture. Existing outboxGet retains committed intent/status but no revision/commit timestamp; row metadata is not a commit marker. DispatchRow retains source/operationId/occurrence/attempt/lifecycle facts, not request/predicate/frozen lexical/commit metadata. The original intent, owning checkpoint and lexical input must come from defining installed source/execution producers, never payload substitution or fabricated commit facts.

Current native stdlib.send refuses options.when (runtime/stdlib.ts294), and Compiler js.rs4888 refuses async guards without owning live observer/frozen lexical transport. Compiler checked source/lowering and Dev genuine private frozen-lexical issuance remain separate native activation prerequisites. Original Workbench query State/Contracts API is already released; Compiler complete original queries/influences/Fact projection and Dev genuine native frame/schema/policy/query-slot/result adapter are separate assigned producers, not missing State query APIs.
requirements: One actual owning eligibility implementation; unavailable/superseded/deferred/settled/live claim must not run source guard or provider.

Run actual source guard once only on eligible command stage before any physical claim/skip mutation. Exact private execution derived from original registry checkpoint and verified original source intent/lexical bindings; no request-selected handle/raw store grant.

Close handle before consuming evidence. Retain original State revision, all positive/negative observation checks and fresh current authority through final bounded single expectedRevision commit; do not cache early authority or replay source predicate.

Actual false stages owning guard-false outcome without claim/attempt increment; false evidence and authority validated before skip writes commit. Stale claim reclaim remains valid and same existing owning eligibility.

Caught source/provenance/concurrency/unawaited/unknown-Bool failures refuse, poisoned/closed/copied contexts cannot bypass. Checkpoint conflict/storage errors retain existing behavior. Legacy synchronous API/default commands stay compatible.

Implement full port behavior rather than metadata-only scaffolding or broader unproven workflow claims. Minimal owned records and finite defining tests; Dev native adoption remains exact separately owned prerequisite.
state.evaluation: Compare all alternatives against identical complete outcomes, necessary trusted machinery, lifetime/provenance, single evaluation and stage-to-commit evidence. No alternative gets credit for assuming an absent API; evaluate proposed implementations as proposed.

join.instructions: For the verified State/Work/native repository state, select the least additional trustworthy machinery that implements every required preclaim and terminal-skip outcome. Compare A, B and C as proposed implementations on equal requirements; account for actual eligibility ownership, stage lifetime, current authority and original revision.

criteria.A: Proposed State private registry-stage ledger keyed by the actual issued context exposes its read-only original revision and bounded commit-check enrollment; closes enrollment after actual command.stage and consumes strict checks immediately before the original single commit. Extend the actual Work claim factory with a literal installed guard-phase callback only after its existing eligibility/availability. Reuse existing runDispatchGuardPhase, transfer its closed evidence plus current authority into State ledger; true stages existing claim, false reuses owning pending/guard-false/claim-clear/ack semantics without physically claiming or consuming an attempt. Dev future installed callback supplies verified original intent/lexical/source-owner facts and exact row correspondence. Adds State stage/enrollment and Work eligible callback ports; no copied eligibility or new Work execution phase.
criteria.B: Proposed State registry binds a post-stage precommit continuation to the actual command output. Work returns an opaque eligible-claim continuation retaining original row and owning false replacement; State/Dev continuation reuses existing runDispatchGuardPhase at original revision after staging validation, selects only permitted existing claim or owning skip effects, then consumes closed observation/current-authority checks before original commit. Keeps eligibility once and no physical claim before guard; requires private Work effect-choice continuation and State output binding with one-shot lifetime/poisoning. No arbitrary write replacement or assumed existing continuation API.
criteria.C: Proposed State suspend/resume system execution returns an opaque original eligible staged run/checkpoint with bounded lifetime. Dev evaluates actual guard once through existing runDispatchGuardPhase, then resumes permitted owning claim/skip continuation; State consumes closed evidence/current authority and commits original revision once. Requires explicit cancellation/abandonment/replay/concurrent-resume handling and new resumable ABI, with readers-only/raw-write restrictions and Work eligibility kept once. No assumed existing suspension or new private Work handle phase.
